privacy: Only static same-origin GET network requests observed. Research, videos and metrics stayed in browser IndexedDB. No relay, cookie-session service or desktop connection.
donors: existing Reel Anatomy Python Store and production interface
limitations: Real iPhone/Safari installation and codec behaviour have not been physically tested.
Phone transcription and learned semantic models are not included. Import SRT/VTT or Windows analysis JSON.
File exchange is explicit; automatic cross-device synchronisation is not included.
Backups exclude original media. Browser storage can be evicted.
Generated fixtures validate workflow, not real campaign uplift or massive-corpus performance.
prior_denials: The denied Cloudflare relay operations were not repeated or redirected. The relay candidate remains undeployed.
